class.name: ARRaycastHit
class.brief_description: Copied intersection with a detected plane polygon.
class.description: Returned nearest first by ARView.raycast or [method PocketAR.raycast_planes]. Only tracking, unsubsumed polygon front faces are intersected. Hit values remain readable after later frames; they do not track subsequent plane motion or create an anchor. Discard identities when the session generation changes.

members.member: Plane alignment as an [enum ARPlaneTracker.Alignment] ordinal, not a mask bit.
Distance in metres from the ray origin. ARView rays start on the near plane, not at the camera centre.
Frame ID of the packet used for this intersection.
World-space hit transform in metres. +Y follows the plane normal; +Z points toward the incoming ray projected on the plane, using the plane +Z for a perpendicular ray.
Generation of the packet used for this intersection.
